title: Engagement Space Confirms
description: Engagement and possible engagements must not contain spaces. Spacebar confirms (same as Enter), not insert a space character.
summary:
Engagement command text no longer accepts whitespace; Space confirms like Enter instead of inserting a character.

- ui/react: engagementCommandTextWithoutSpaces on draft/onChange/routed keys; Space and Enter share confirm handler; routeWindowEngagementKeydown ignores Space.
- cad/js/renderer: replNormalizeCommandText always strips whitespace; global Space in engagement mode calls submitEngagementLine instead of appending a space.

Tests: @semio-tech/ui-react 89 passed, @semio-tech/cad-js-renderer 66 passed.
